scope.selector: F(T,p)={original leaf v: Delta_p(T-v)<0}, fixed throughout

definitions.q_v_j: i_j(H_v)-i_j(R_v) = number of independent j-sets of H_v meeting W_v
definitions.K_j: Q-vector space on pairs (v,A) with v in F, A independent in H_v, |A|=j, A intersects W_v

operator.name: L cross-tag deletion
operator.tag_order: fixed total order on original leaves
operator.definition: For each (v,A), and each u in A, put B=A\{u}. If B meets W_v tag it by v; otherwise tag it by the least w in F with B independent in H_w and B meeting W_w; omit term if no such w. Sum the resulting (tag,B) with simplicial deletion sign (-1)^(position(u,A)-1). Extend linearly over Q.
operator.sufficient_missing_property: L injective for every eligible T,p
operator.stronger_matching_certificate: A distinct displayed output tagged face for every input tagged face, with no output repeated, gives a full-rank minor.

limitations: No proof that L is injective.
Noninjectivity of L would not imply S(T,p)>0.
No finite computational horizon or universal conclusion is claimed.
